reason: I always forget my bottle at home when I travel, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my gym bag actually fits my life. At the $24.99 launch price I would try one box, and the named lab report is a nice extra.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. At full price I would probably go back to a cheaper bottle.
